Dr. '''Patrick Stephen Herendeen''' (born 1959) is an American [[botanist]] with expertise in [[paleobotany]] and [[evolutionary biology]] of [[Cretaceous]] Age fossil plants. He is the Senior Director of Systematics and Evolutionary Biology and Senior Scientist at the [[Chicago Botanic Garden]] and teaches at [[Northwestern University]].<ref name="cbg">{{cite web |title=Patrick S. Herendeen, Ph.D. |url=https://www.chicagobotanic.org/research/staff/herendeen |website=chicagobotanic.org |publisher=Chicago Botanic Garden |accessdate=2018-09-22 |language=en}}</ref><ref name="usgs">{{cite web |title=Herendeen, Patrick - Biography |url=https://www.pwrc.usgs.gov/resshow/perry/bios/HerendeenPatrick.htm |website=pwrc.usgs.gov |accessdate=2018-09-22}}</ref> Herendeen is the president of the [[International Association for Plant Taxonomy]].<ref name="iapt">{{cite web |title=IAPT - Council |url=https://www.iaptglobal.org/council |website=iaptglobal.org |publisher=International Association for Plant Taxonomy |accessdate=2018-09-22 |language=en}}</ref>
